An update, earlier today
An industrious lull is easier with a plan
Travelers, please note that baggage and pet handoff checks may run a little slower while we clear a disrupted departure flow at Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk notice

We are keeping a close watch on every companion animal booking and giving extra care to the animals already in our system. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey. Our handlers are using calm, humane methods and checking each care plan for species, temperament, and comfort before any move from one area to another. If your pet is traveling with us, please keep carrier labels clear and stay close to the desk when your name is called.

For delayed departure cases, <<FACT F109>>. We know this can be frustrating, so we are working through each traveler case in order and keeping notes current for the team on the floor. If you are traveling with a pet like Sparky, please have documents ready and follow the guidance from the desk so the process stays steady and low-stress.

Please check in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you head onward, and we will help you with the next steps.
